reason: On the reached state, pressing Submit leaves focus on the Submit button, and the Mercury account balance error message "Please complete this field" appears in a plain div. The AX probe shows the container has no role, no ancestor is a live region, alert or status, and the page's only live regions (DndLiveRegion, the transactions table, toast-container) hold no error text. A screen-reader user who presses Submit hears nothing and must Tab back through every field to learn why the form did not send. That fails 4.1.3. The task is possible but hard, and this form does not move money, so it stays medium.
